_note: RFC 9421 proof-of-possession signature-base vectors for the bound-retrieval GET (ADR-013 D2/D4). Pins the byte-identical @target-uri signature base across the TS edge verifier (src/edge/src/pop.ts signatureBase), the Python agent signer (src/mcp ramp_mcp_shim.httpsig.pop_signature_base), and the TS test signer (src/edge/tests/helpers/ed25519.ts). Each entry's expected_base is exactly what the fetcher signs and the edge reconstructs; a divergence in line order, quoting, or the params string rejects every bound fetch. The last vector uses the RFC 8032 Ed25519 test key as the bound agent_id.
